subject: Vendor onboarding: Atlas Medical Supplies — buyer intake & payment details
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@atlas-med.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Atlas Medical Supplies — buyer intake & payment details

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the upcoming supply integration. To get Atlas set up in our procurement system and enable POs, can you please complete the attached buyer intake worksheet and return the following items? We aim to complete vendor setup within 2 business days once we have everything.

Required for vendor creation:
- Legal entity name as registered with IRS
- Tax ID / EIN (you can send full EIN or last 4 digits if you prefer; we just need to validate)
- Registered address and remit-to address (if different)
- W-9 or equivalent tax document (PDF)
- Preferred payment method: ACH (bank name, routing, account), or wire (bank + beneficiary details)
- Remit email for invoices and invoice contact person

Optional but helpful: vendor contact for PO questions, invoice samples, and any billing codes you use.

A couple notes on our side:
- Standard terms are Net30 unless otherwise agreed; if you need Net45/60, flag it now and we'll route for approvals.
- Once vendor record is created, we'll issue the first PO and send a confirmation to the remit contact.

I've attached our Buyer Onboarding Worksheet to this email. Please return that and the W-9 as attachments to this thread. If you prefer, you can upload sensitive docs to the Drive link below and share a view-only link.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/atlas-onboarding-workflow

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Atlas_Onboarding_Worksheet.pdf (fillable)

- Preferred payment: ACH (we prefer ACH). Bank details are in the attached bank_authorization_form; if you need a wire instead, let me know and I will provide the wire instructions from our treasury team.

Attachments: Atlas_Onboarding_Worksheet.pdf (completed), W-9_Atlas_Medical.pdf (pdf), bank_authorization_form.pdf (fillable)

Grace / Lauren — quick procurement checklist after reviewing Ben's attachments:

1) Validate W-9: confirm legal name matches worksheet and EIN format. Ben provided EIN 12-3456789 — please mask in Hub for security but keep full on file in vendor docs.
2) Remit address OK (800 Harbor Blvd). Confirm invoice samples (we have none attached).
3) Bank authorization form received. For ACH setup, Treasury needs last 4 digits of the account to verify. Ask Ben to confirm last 4 via this thread or a secure link.
4) Suggested default terms: Net30. If Atlas requests different terms escalate to Finance.
5) Create vendor record VND-00671 in Coupa (or AP system) and link attachments (worksheet, W-9, bank form).
6) Add contact finance@atlas-med.com as invoice recipient and set remittance email to that address.

I'll take vendor record creation and flag for PO issuance as soon as Ben confirms last 4 digits for ACH. Grace, if you want earlier payment terms or a first PO before full verification, let me know and I'll open an exception request.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Vendor Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the W-9 and bank form. Dev has started vendor creation — vendor code VND-00671 will be created today. Before we finish ACH setup and issue the first PO, could you please confirm the last 4 digits of the ACH account on file (you can reply to this thread or update the bank_authorization_form on the Drive link). We will only use those digits to verify with the bank.

If everything looks good I will confirm once PO-2027-0558 is sent. If you need Net45/60 or a different payment arrangement, please raise it now so we can route approvals.

Thanks again — excited to get this live.
